commits.message: Delete requirements.txt

Pylint fixes

Cleaned the code up a bit.

Updated review.html

Updated if statement regex and placeholder.

Updated review.html

Added error handling to the file. This will cause an error message to be shown should something go wrong.

Updated routes.py

Routess.py is now able to handle an error coming in from database_control.add_review(). This will cause the review.html page to reload with an error message.

Databasecontrol.py update

Added error handling. If an error happens during the update of a reviews teacher, material or workload info, the review will be deleted and the unction returns true. Otherwise it will return false. This way there will be no empty reviews in the database.

Database.py update

Added handling for a possible list element coming in as teacher name. All names will be individually added to the database.

Updated routes.py

Added the possibility to detect if there are multiple names in the teacher box or just one.

review.html update

Allowing only one teacher name to be input.

Updated createaccount.html

Added a form if statement to check if password is at least 8 characters long. Added placeholders to text type inputs.

Updated teachers.html

Added the teacher name as a kind of a title before the button to visit the teacher's page.

Updated courses.html

Added the course name and id as a kind of a title before the button to visit the course's page.

Updated main.css

Changed the width of an li form element.

Updated search.html

Added a division element on the button.

Updated courses.html

Added script to check if admin has given some incorrect input.

Updated review.html

Fixed typo.

Updated review.html

Added some placeholders to text type inputs.

Updated loginpage.html

Added some placeholders to text type inputs.

.CSS files update

Styling update to make pages render correctly on mobile screens. Changed scaling units to be more accurate. Added some more specificity to styling.

Updated index.html

Updated reviewed_courses to match the data routes.py sends.

Updated routes excepts

Added some expected errors to the functions excepting errors.

Updated readme.md

Readme has some updated info on what the app can do.

Updated schema.sql

Added some inserts to make testing the app more interesting. To see more the user must do their own review.

Updated createaccount.html

Added the if statement to check if the form is empty.

createaccount.html update

Added a new if statement to check that the username has no special characters in it. Only the alphabet, numbers, and the underscore character are allowed. Password has the same requirements except !, #, %, ?, and & are allowed as well.
Removed whitespace

.py file function comments

Added simple comments to help identify what the function does.

Updated renamed.html

Added a route to go back to the courses page.

Updated schema.sql

Added INSERT function adding an admin user so the app function will be easier to test.

Updated renamed.html

Renamed html now reacts to the info it gets and renders a delete button or the rename info.

Updated courses.html

Courses.html now has a form allowing the admin to delete a course they don't want in the database.

Updated delete.html

Delete.html now tells the admin which course has been deleted.

Created route /delete

Created route /delete which can be accessed through the /rename page. Tweaked the rename route to notice when the admin is requesting to move to the rename or delete page. The meaning of the delete and rename routes is the easier testing of the database and removing test data.

Created file delete.html

Created file delete.html and copy pasted the renamed.html file in it.

review.html update

Added if statements to the check form function to make sure the input for a teacher name consists only of numbers. A connective line for joint names is allowed.

Routes.py update

Created regex checking the input from the review form. This way no system breaking information ends up in the database.

review.html input handling

Added if statements checking if there are extra newline characters in the course_name, course_id, or teacher_name forms.

review.html input handling update

Added new if statements in the check form function. No whitespace is allowed when adding a course id, and no double space in course, or teacher names.

search function input control

Added whitespace removing regex to make the input given by the user usable in the course_exists and teacher_exists functions. Also added try and except to make sure the function gets to finish even with an error.

index.html search input control

Added script checking if the search bar actually has some input. the user gets an alert if there is only whitespace.

Updated routes.py

When detecting error the search route did not load the index page correctly with the error. Added the required data to the render_template to render index.html correctly after an error.

Update db.py

Changed database url to not match the fly.io requirement.

Updated createaccount.html

Added a password check function to verify for typos in the password. Added an alert function if the two passwords don't match. Also fixed a too early return in the errors function.

Updated createaccount.html

Added check to block whitespace in passwords.

Updated teachers.html

Added teacher_count to show how many unique teacher names there are in the database.

Updated index.html

Added review_count to index.html with different outputs for different inputs. Added some instructions for users who wish to start reviewing courses. Stats on the frontpage only show up if there are stats to show.

Updated courses.html

Added course_count to courses.html. Also added instructions to log in for users.

routes.py update

Added count_reviews to index route, added count_teachers to teachers route, and added count_courses to courses route. The data from these functions is sent to the .html files.

Defined functions in stats.py

Defined count_courses, count_teachers, and count_reviews.

Created three new functions

New functions will give some numerical stats of the database.

Changed form textarea color

Textarea text was difficult to read when the background was so dark.

Updated users.py

Added a newline to line with too many characters.

Updated routes.py

Added a newline to a line with too many characters.

Update courses.html

Added the option for an admin to change a course name if it is inappropriate or otherwise incorrect.  Also changed navbar list items order.

Admin update

The index.html informs an user when they are logged in as an admin. Also changed navbar list items order.

Navbar update

Changed order of list items in navbar.

Navbar update

I didn't like the way the objects in the navbar were displayed and changed order.

Fixed users.py functions

Fixed is admin function problem where admin rights were not properly restricted.

Renamed.html update

The text informs the admin of what changes have been made.

Updated renamed.html

Renamed.html now has doctype, style, and a body containing the header and navbar.
Created renamed.html

Updated new function

Defined a new function called rename_course which allows the admin to rename a poorly named course.

Update on create_user function

Added SQL to define that new users are not admins by default.

Updated routes.py

Added the admin option as a session. This can be requested on all html.files.

Update on delete option

Updated the tables to have the delete cascade option, so all referencing tables will be deleted at the same time.

New function to database_control.py

Defined new function called delete_course. This will fully delete all occurrences of a course from the database.

Created is_admin function

Is_admin checks for the admin rights of a user.

Updated database

Added admin option to users, also added DROP TABLE commands to make it easier to recreate the whole database.

Review.html error detection

Added a script to tell user not to input whitespace when entering a course id. This blocks whitespace from ending up in the sql system.

Database_control fix

Fixed issue where a course could be entered with whitespace in the add_course function.

Visual update on result.html

Changed the button position.

Updated review.css visuals

Readjusted some background colors in review.css to better match the forest theme. Added a div styling to review.css.

Visual update on review.html

Added divisions to review.html.

Update to top lists

Top lists now show the course id in addition to the name.

SQL fixes in stats.py

Functions latest_reviews, best_material, and best_workload now return the course id in addition to name.
best_teacher function now returns the teachers name instead of the course name.
Fixed typo

Updated stats.py

Added comments. Changed best_teacher() to return the names of the teachers, not the course.

Updated routes.py newaccount function

Added a working error detection to the function. users.create_user() returns a bool value which indicates what measures to take.

Error messages in createaccount.html

Added error possibility to the createaccount.html form informing the user if the attempted username exists.

users.py create_user error messaging

Added actual, visible error messages to the create user function. Removed prints used for debugging.

Update on main.css

Gave div category a bit more left padding. Additional 3em.

Updated index.html

Changed the variable course_id name to search_data, to match the routes.search function. Also added error messaging to show on the form after an unsuccessful search.
Visual changes: added some divisions to the page.

Changes to variable names

Changed the variable course_id name to search_data, to match the routes.search function.

Updated routes.py

Updated the search route function. Changed variable names course_id to search_data. Changed render address to search.html. Changed error messages to show on the from after an unsuccessful search.

Deleted search_teacher.html

Search_teacher.html became useless after the updated search.html started handling all searches.

Renamed search_course.html

Search_course.html is now search.html.

Updated teachers.html

Changed the post address to work appropriately with the newly updated routes.search_course function.

Removed search teacher bar from index.html

Removed one search bar from the front page making the page simpler and easier to understand.

Updated search_course function

Updated the function to also handle the search_teacher option this way only one search bar can be used to search teachers and courses.

Joined search_course.html and search teacher.html

Added a function checking the page input to load either teacher data or course data. Thought it would be better to handle it all on one page.

Updated coursepage.css

Changed the nav li padding so all the links are on the same line in the navbar.

Updated review.css

Changed colors to match the page theme and made the navbar padding smaller so all the links fit on the same line.

Updated main.css

Changed the navbar size so all needed links are on the same line.

Updated courses.html

This is basically a copypaste of the teachers.html. Changes can be seen where the course id and name are called as they come from separate columns in the database.

Updated routes.py

Added courses route. This will load the courses.html file.

Created courses.html

Courses html will hold a list of all courses in the database.

Navbar update, index.html and teachers.html

Added link to courses to teachers.html and index.html navbars.

Navbar update

Added links to courses and teachers to each .html file showing the navbar.

Main.css update

Added ul li color.

Updated index.html navbar

Added the teachers link to the navbar.
